english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for a person who shows little compassion, consideration, or human warmth, including tactless behavior.
Use this when the person seems cold, lacking sympathy, or unwilling to show kindness rather than merely unpleasant.
Use this softer choice when stressing a lack of warmth, sympathy, or human feeling rather than outright cruelty.

examples.english: They do not even comfort people when they see them so upset; they are really insensitive.
examples.traditional: 佢見到人哋咁傷心都唔安慰，真係冇人情味。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 gam3 soeng1 sam1 dou1 m4 on1 wai3 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 cing4 mei6

examples.english: They saw how badly off the others were and still would not help; that was really unkind.
examples.traditional: 佢見到人哋咁慘都唔肯幫手，真係冇人情味。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 gam3 caam2 dou1 m4 hang2 bong1 sau2 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 cing4 mei6

examples.english: It was callous of him to ask when I would repay him even though he knew I was unemployed.
examples.traditional: 佢明知我失業，仲問我幾時還錢，真係冇人情味。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 ming4 zi1 ngo5 sat1 jip6 zung6 man6 ngo5 gei2 si4 waan4 cin2 zan1 hai6 mou5 jan4 cing4 mei6
